teaching.example: There is a green lizard on my shoe.
teaching.example_zh: 我的鞋子上有一只绿色蜥蜴。

extra_examples.en: The lizard has a long tail.
extra_examples.zh: 这只蜥蜴有一条长尾巴。

teaching.student_prompt: 在图里找出蜥蜴的四条腿和尾巴，再用 lizard 说一句话。
teaching.cloze: There is a green __________ on my shoe.
teaching.cloze_zh: 我的鞋子上有一只绿色蜥蜴。
teaching.note: 先读单词与例句，再用 word_study 学习来源和构成；关联例句均为原创。

word_study.explanation_zh: lizard 是一个完整的动物名称，不拆成 liz + ard。可以用复数和简单搭配，把它放进不同的句子。
word_study.origin_zh: lizard 经法语 lesarde 追溯到拉丁语 lacerta，都是蜥蜴的名称。它并不是两个现代英语词拼在一起。

family.connection_zh: lizard + -s：不止一只蜥蜴；这是词形变化。

example.en: Two lizards sit on a rock.
example.zh: 两只蜥蜴待在一块石头上。

family.connection_zh: pet（宠物）修饰 lizard，说明它和人的关系。

challenge.prompt_zh: lizard + -s = lizards。这里的 -s 表示一个还是多个？

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: classroom vocabulary/story photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners, shown large on a projector.
Style: beautiful, playful, predominantly photorealistic natural editorial educational photography; bright daylight, rich but plausible colors, realistic skin, real materials, correct anatomy, warm humour. Uncluttered composition with a strong main subject and high visual quality. Landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 1536 by 1024.
Global constraints: no embedded text, letters, captions, logos, watermarks, UI labels, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All children are fictional, ordinary fully clothed, in benign learning scenes. Natural plausible scale and perspective. Friendly safe environments.
Recurring characters whenever named: Mia is a fictional East Asian girl about 9, black ponytail, coral-red light jacket, pale-blue jeans, white trainers. Ben is a fictional East Asian boy about 9, short black hair. In farm-story scenes Ben wears a child-size blue two-piece formal suit, white shirt, yellow rain boots. A recurring lizard is a small vivid green realistic garden lizard, long tail, four anatomically correct legs, not a chameleon.

Primary request: a sharp close-up natural wildlife photograph of a small vivid bright green realistic garden lizard basking on a smooth sunlit rock. Its full long tapering tail and four anatomically correct legs and feet are visible, with finely textured scaled skin and a curious friendly pose. Side three-quarter view with head raised, body unobscured, plausible slender lizard proportions. Beautiful green garden bokeh, strong subject separation. It is a real small lizard, not a dinosaur, toy, cartoon, gecko caricature or chameleon; no horn or oversized features.
